question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT 0 as interval UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
legislator_intervals AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.first_term_start,
        i.interval,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', DATE(ft.first_term_start)) + INTERVAL (i.interval + 1) YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY as check_date_dec31
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN intervals i
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        li.id_bioguide,
        li.interval,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = li.id_bioguide
            AND DATE(lt.term_start) <= li.check_date_dec31
            AND DATE(lt.term_end) >= li.check_date_dec31
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
    FROM legislator_intervals li
),
legislator_info AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        gender,
        (SELECT state FROM legislators_terms WHERE id_bioguide = li.id_bioguide AND term_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as state
    FROM legislators li
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        li2.state,
        li2.gender,
        rc.interval,
        COUNT(*) as total_legislators,
        SUM(rc.retained) as retained_count,
        1.0 * SUM(rc.retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM retention_check rc
    JOIN legislator_info li2 ON rc.id_bioguide = li2.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY li2.state, li2.gender, rc.interval
),
min_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        MIN(retention_rate) as min_retention_rate
    FROM state_gender_retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
qualified_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM min_retention
    WHERE min_retention_rate > 0
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gender) = 2
)
SELECT state
FROM qualified_states
ORDER BY state;

    CROSS JOIN intervals i
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        li.id_bioguide,
        li.interval,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = li.id_bioguide
            AND DATE(lt.term_start) <= li.check_date_dec31
            AND DATE(lt.term_end) >= li.check_date_dec31
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
    FROM legislator_intervals li
),
legislator_info AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        gender,
        (SELECT state FROM legislators_terms WHERE id_bioguide = li.id_bioguide AND term_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as state
    FROM legislators li
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        li2.state,
        li2.gender,
        rc.interval,
        COUNT(*) as total_legislators,
        SUM(rc.retained) as retained_count,
        1.0 * SUM(rc.retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM retention_check rc
    JOIN legislator_info li2 ON rc.id_bioguide = li2.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY li2.state, li2.gender, rc.interval
),
min_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        MIN(retention_rate) as min_retention_rate
    FROM state_gender_retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
qualified_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM min_retention
    WHERE min_retention_rate > 0
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gender) = 2
)
SELECT state
FROM qualified_states
ORDER BY state;
